recording.lineage: Reel To Reel > CD Burner > Roxio Sound Editor > Wav > Flac Frontend | --Recorded my Reel with a TEAC 2300S reel to reel into a 1997 Sony CD Burner (Analogue to Digital with RCA cable outpout on the TEAC and input to the burner). Ripped the CD's that were burned using Roxio import CD function on my Windows 7 computer and saved them as 14H kbps / 44 kHz .wav files . Tracked and adjusted volume of the .wav files using Roxio Sound Editor (2009). converted to Flac Frontend - flac 16.
